raw_comment:
- I notice that the spot on the chart farthest from "exceptional drought" is labelled "abnormally dry," implying that the United States altogether is experiencing a period of remarkable drought. It's peculiar that the graph goes out of the way to avoid sharing this insight outright, even going so far as to label the level one worse than "abnormally dry" as "moderate," which feels misleading. 
- I wonder why some of the states known for being particularly hot and dry, namely Texas and California, aren't the states experiencing the highest drought conditions. I wonder what phenomena could have occurred to cause such a situation.
- I notice that a majority of Michigan is suffering "severe" drought conditions, although our particular area is only in the "abnormally dry" section, which still isn't ideal. If this map is to be believed, this drought seems to be a national crisis, and should be addressed. 
- Desert Warfare: Drought Ravages America
